text:
sarah (CEO): quick post-all-hands update re: the reorg + hiring plan. i'll keep bullets short and actionable. pls reply with specific asks.
jen (Recruiting): is this a freeze or reprioritization?
dave (CTO): reprioritization. gating for next 2 quarters: Serving/runtime, Dedicated capacity, and customer SLA work get expedited approvals.
lina (Dir Eng): to be explicit: teams reducing latency, improving KV/prefix caching, autoscaling, and failover reliability are top priority.
cam (Product): PMs: how do we ask for priority?
omar (People Ops): open a ticket in internal/hires, tag @jen + @lina, include a one-line impact statement + "priority-bucket". weekly triage.
ash (Eng): internal transfers? any special path?
omar (People Ops): internal moves encouraged. post in #internal-moves and cc your manager; transfers are fast-tracked.
jen (Recruiting): interview loops will be trimmed for infra roles to speed decisions; recruiters will send loop updates this week.
dave (CTO): hiring mix guidance: ~60% senior+, ~40% mid-level; junior hires only with clear mentorship plans.
cam (Product): what about product/growth roles?
sarah (CEO): still funded but fewer slots; tie to revenue/retention metrics for faster approval.
jen (Recruiting): urgent customer-related hires: tag ticket "urgent-customer" and include the contract/SLA; that bumps triage.
ash (Eng): visa/relocation impact?
omar (People Ops): existing offers untouched; new sponsorship reqs evaluated per region/budget. flag on intake.
sarah (CEO): we'll publish an org map + read-only headcount buckets by EOD Fri. thanks — we'll host a short AMA if there's demand. :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: all-hands follow-up doc uploaded: internal/allhands/2026-06-12-summary.md
